items.title: LAUGFS slashes 12.5kg gas price to Rs. 5,995
items.summary: LAUGFS Gas PLC has announced a Rs. 745 reduction in the price of a 12.5kg domestic LPG cylinder, bringing the price down from Rs. 6,740 to Rs. 5,995 with effect from midnight today (November 17).

items.title: IRD exceeds 2026 target with Rs. 2.44 trillion collection
items.summary: The Inland Revenue Department (IRD) has surpassed its annual revenue target of Rs. 2,402 billion for 2026, collecting Rs. 2,441.9 billion as of November 16, the department announced.

items.title: Seven new envoys present credentials to President
items.summary: Seven newly appointed Ambassadors and High Commissioners presented their Letters of Credence to President Anura Kumara Dissanayake at a ceremony held at the Presidential Secretariat on Tuesday (17).

items.title: Pope forgives person who nailed him in the eye with a rosary in Peru
items.summary: Pope Leo XIV has forgiven the person who threw a rosary at him before his final Mass in Peru and nailed him in the eye, saying it was merely a sign of the person’s profound faith.
